# gitmoap_provider_listing (Data Source)

A provider's marketplace page. Its README, examples and badges, and its versions with their changelogs and whether each publishes an SBOM. A private provider's page is visible only to members of the organization that owns it. Open to any signed-in caller.

The token needs `provider_catalog:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_id` (String) Provider slug

### Read-Only

- `categories` (List of String)
- `examples` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--examples))
- `homepage_url` (String)
- `install_count` (Number)
- `keywords` (List of String)
- `namespace_verified` (Boolean)
- `publisher` (Attributes) Who publishes a provider, and whether they are verified. Shown for providers gitmoap does not
build itself. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--publisher))
- `readme` (String)
- `repository_url` (String)
- `versions` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--examples"></a>
### Nested Schema for `examples`

Read-Only:

- `capability_ids` (List of String) The capabilities this example exercises; each must exist in some
published version of the provider (validated at write time).
- `description` (String) One- or two-sentence summary (<= 500 chars).
- `snippet` (String) A pipeline YAML/JSON fragment (<= 8 KB).
- `title` (String) Short heading (<= 120 chars).


<a id="nestedatt--publisher"></a>
### Nested Schema for `publisher`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String)
- `namespace` (String)
- `publisher_id` (String)
- `verification_method` (String) How a publisher's `verified` flag was earned. `Manual` is the platform-admin
grant (D3); `Dns` / `Github` are the self-service namespace-ownership proofs.
- `verification_target` (String)
- `verified` (Boolean)


<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `changelog` (String)
- `lifecycle_state` (String) Lifecycle state of a published `ProviderVersionManifest`. `Active` is the
default; `Deprecated` still runs but the trigger-time validator surfaces a
warning; `Sunset` runs only inside its grace window, after which a trigger
referencing it fails validation.
- `published_at` (String)
- `published_by` (String)
- `sbom_available` (Boolean) Whether a software bill of materials (SBOM) is available for this version, as it is for
platform and verified providers.
- `signed` (Boolean)
- `version` (String)
